guest.body: Guest room scoping is an application policy, not a cryptographic boundary. Rotate gateway secrets after removing members or revoking invitations; revocation is not remote data erasure.
guest.heading: Guests and invitations

license.body: Source and issue tracker links are listed in the release notes. This page never shows endpoints, tokens or secrets.
license.heading: License and feedback

open_source.body: This project uses HarmonyOS ArkUI and the Hypium test framework. The full license list ships with the release package.
open_source.heading: Open source

privacy.body: Family, device, room and scene data stay on this device. The app has no proprietary server and only contacts a cloud platform after manual configuration.
privacy.heading: Local first
privacy.title: Privacy and connectivity

security.body: LAN control uses P-HMAC (integrity and replay protection only, no confidentiality) or P-TLS-PIN (TLS with pinned certificates). Choose according to gateway capability and protect the local profile password.
security.heading: Security boundary
